start: Owner in Settings on Chrome, online gym, alerts never turned on in this browser

steps.action: Find the card "Alerts from your members"
user_sees: "Get a notice on this phone or computer when a member needs you, even when the admin app is closed. A tap opens the right page."
Button "Turn on alerts on this device"
must_not: The card in a gym whose server has no alerts yet

steps.action: Tap "Turn on alerts on this device" and allow notifications in the browser question
user_sees: "Alerts are on for this device."
The button now reads "Turn off on this device"
must_not: "On" shown although the browser address was not saved
Two saved addresses for one browser

steps.action: Tap "Send a test alert"
user_sees: "We are sending a test alert to this device. It can take up to a minute. You can close the admin app now to check that alerts come when it is closed."
must_not: The test going to any other device
A second test allowed at once

steps.action: Close the admin app and wait
user_sees: A notice on the device within about a minute
Back in Settings: "Sent. Did a notice pop up? It showed on this device at <time>."
must_not: "Sent" shown when the device showed nothing
A time on another clock than this device's

start: Other way in: the bell at the top right, alerts off in this browser, card not closed before

steps.action: Tap the bell
user_sees: A card at the top "Turn on alerts": "Get a notice on this phone or computer when a member needs you, even when the admin app is closed."
"If you close this card, you can still turn alerts on in Settings."
must_not: The card where the browser cannot show alerts
The card after alerts are already on

steps.action: Tap the card's button and allow notifications
user_sees: The card goes; alerts are on for this device
must_not: The card back on the next open

steps.action: On another browser tap "Close this card" instead
user_sees: The card goes and stays away on this device
must_not: Alerts turned on without a yes
The card gone on other devices too

start: Owner in Settings, three browsers: notifications blocked; an iPhone in Safari; an old browser

steps.action: Blocked browser: open the card
user_sees: "Alerts are blocked in this browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser settings, then come back here."
must_not: A button that asks again and again
"On" shown

steps.action: iPhone in Safari (not added to Home Screen): open the card
user_sees: "On an iPhone or iPad, first add the admin app to your Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen). Open it from there and turn alerts on."
must_not: A dead "Turn on" button

steps.action: Old browser: open the card
user_sees: "This browser cannot show alerts when the admin app is closed. Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox."
must_not: A crash or an empty card

steps.action: In a working browser tap "Send a test alert" twice within a minute
user_sees: "You just sent a test. You can send another in <n> seconds."
must_not: Two tests sent

steps.action: Turn the internet off and tap "Turn on alerts on this device"
user_sees: "Alerts could not be turned on. Check the internet and try again."
must_not: "On" shown with nothing saved

start: Owner in Settings, alerts on for this device

steps.action: Under "The rest (questions, messages, feedback, online payments, new members, workout reports):" pick "Once a week", a Day and a Time, tap "Save"
user_sees: "Saved."
must_not: Save allowed with nothing changed
The urgent kinds delayed too

steps.action: Pick "Instantly" and save, then "Once a day" at 11:00 am and save
user_sees: "Saved." each time
must_not: The old choice back after a reload

steps.action: Tap "Turn off on this device"
user_sees: "Alerts are off for this device."
must_not: Alerts still arriving on this device
Other devices of the gym turned off too

steps.action: Tap "Turn on alerts on this device" again
user_sees: "Alerts are on for this device."
must_not: A new permission question each time
A double address so each alert comes twice

start: Owner and one front-desk person, both with alerts on, each on their own device

steps.action: A member sends a complaint to the owner only
user_sees: The owner's device gets it at once

Owner card line: "These always come at once: complaints, new shop orders, a member waiting at the check-in poster, a friend who wants to join, and a pause or renew request when the plan is about to end."
must_not: The desk's device getting a complaint meant for the owner only
The member's words or phone number on a locked screen beyond what the bell shows

steps.action: The owner taps "Send a test alert"
user_sees: Only the owner's device shows the test
must_not: The desk's device or the owner's other browser showing the test

steps.action: The owner signs out on this device
user_sees: unknown
must_not: Alerts for this gym still arriving on a signed-out device (not checked in this pass)

start: Front-desk sign-in in Settings on Chrome, alerts never turned on in this browser

steps.action: Find "Alerts from your members" and tap "Turn on alerts on this device"; allow notifications
user_sees: "Alerts are on for this device."
must_not: The owner's device changed in any way

steps.action: Read the lines under it
user_sees: "These always come at once: new shop orders, a member waiting at the check-in poster, a friend who wants to join, a pause or renew request when the plan is about to end, and complaints sent to "Gym admin"."
"Your gym gets everything else together, every day at 11:00 am." (or the owner's choice)
must_not: The owner's line that promises all complaints

steps.action: Tap "Send a test alert" and close the admin app
user_sees: A notice on this device; later "Sent. Did a notice pop up? It showed on this device at <time>."
must_not: The test on any other device

start: Front-desk sign-in in Settings, alerts on

steps.action: Look for the choices Instantly / Once a day / Once a week
user_sees: No choices to change; "Only the owner can change when they come."
must_not: A Save button the desk can press
The gym's timing changed by a desk sign-in

steps.action: In a browser with notifications blocked open the card
user_sees: "Alerts are blocked in this browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser settings, then come back here."
must_not: "On" shown

start: Front-desk sign-in, alerts on for this device

steps.action: Tap "Turn off on this device"
user_sees: "Alerts are off for this device."
must_not: The owner's or another desk person's device turned off

steps.action: Tap "Turn on alerts on this device"
user_sees: "Alerts are on for this device."
must_not: Each alert arriving twice afterwards

steps.action: The owner changes the timing to "Once a week"; the desk reopens Settings
user_sees: "Your gym gets everything else together, every <day> at <time>."
must_not: The old daily line

start: Front desk with alerts on; a member writes a complaint

steps.action: The member sends the complaint to the owner only
user_sees: Nothing on the desk's device
must_not: The complaint, its sender or its first words on the desk's device

steps.action: Another member sends a complaint to "Gym admin"
user_sees: A notice on the desk's device at once
must_not: It held back for the daily summary

steps.action: A second desk person signs in on the same browser
user_sees: unknown
must_not: The first person's alerts shown to the second person (not checked in this pass)
